article_claim_comparison.conclusion: The independently reconstructed 21-period strategy closely reproduces the claimed volatility, max drawdown and Sharpe, but does not reproduce the claimed 21.7x / 34.56% CAGR. Under the validated close-to-close sequence the result is about 17.756x / 31.84% CAGR.

notes: All 21 rebalance periods now have validated ticker and return results.

The early 2016-2017 legacy periods were independently re-audited from exact SPMO SEC Schedule of Investments sections; 2017-09 required reconstruction across a multipage schedule and still confirmed MSFT as Top 1.
All 21 stored period returns were rechecked against Yahoo Finance Adjusted Close with maximum absolute error below 5.52e-7.
No transaction costs or taxes are included.
